title: Apple: Record Quarter Lifts Near-Term Outlook, Antitrust Risk Clouds
description: Record quarterly revenue with increased dividends and buybacks supports near-term upside, but antitrust scrutiny and potential penalties create uncertainty that keeps the longer-term trend neutral.

title: Adidas raises guidance; ADS shows near-term upside
description: Adidas raised its full-year guidance on robust demand and improving margins, with strong order books across key regions suggesting positive momentum for ADS. However, rising input costs and a cooling consumer could temper gains and introduce some volatility.

title: ETF Speculation Sparks Near-Term BTC Upside
description: Speculation that US regulators may approve spot Bitcoin ETFs has sparked renewed buying, lifting BTC toward recent highs and implying a near-term uptrend. Caution remains about potential volatility and possible reversals if decisions are delayed.

title: Dollar strength weighs on EURUSD amid hawkish US data
description: Hawkish Fed guidance and persistent inflation push US yields higher, supporting the dollar. The euro remains under pressure as rate expectations diverge, keeping EURUSD biased lower in the near term.

title: Alphabet AI model may lift monetization and sentiment for GOOGL
description: Investors welcomed Alphabet's most advanced multimodal AI model, signaling stronger monetization potential across ads, Workspace, and cloud. This could support a near-term upside for GOOGL despite expectations of higher data-center spending.

title: Oil set to rise on coordinated cuts and global supply disruptions
description: A blend of OPEC+ production cuts (and extended Saudi voluntary cuts) alongside outages in Libya and Russia, plus sanctions and Strait of Hormuz risk, tightens global supply and lifts price risk. With thin spare capacity and higher risk premiums, crude and refined products are likely to trend higher into the next quarter.

title: Hawkish Policy and Slowing Growth Pressure SPY Lower
description: Fed officials signaling higher-for-longer rates, persistent inflation, and rising yields imply tighter financial conditions and weaker equity valuations. Manufacturing weakness and broad risk-off sentiment add further downside pressure on SPY, suggesting a downtrend in the near term.
